periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis; the patches are oriented near-vertically with a slight medial slant at the inferior pole.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the vertical axis is approximately 2.5 times greater than the maximum horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering; the patch is noticeably wider at the top and narrows to a rounded point at the bottom.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape; the posterior edge of the dark shoulder band displays a smooth, shallow curve across the spine rather than a sharp V-point.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick; the lateral portion of the dark band occupies approximately one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate; the gap between the dark ear regions is approximately equal to the horizontal width of one ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded; the superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, semi-circular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible lower dentition; noticeable brownish-yellow discoloration on the posterior-most visible white dorsal fur.
